g.text: Search: From a Text Scan to an Inverted-Index Lookup
3 documents, tokenized once, so a query becomes a dictionary lookup instead of a scan
result: Doc 1, Doc 3 -- no scan of any document's text
Without the index: 'contains sales' means reading
every document's full text, every single query --
With it: one lookup into a list built once, ahead of time.
